7159882.baseName: Habitat 3ft Fibre Optic Small Christmas Tree
7159882.variantName: Habitat 3ft Fibre Optic Small Christmas Tree
7159882.sourceDescription: Bring a bit of festive magic into tighter spaces with this 3ft artificial Christmas tree. It's compact, it's ready in minutes, and it lights up on its own. There's no faffing with fairy lights or hunting for decorations. The pieces slot together into the stand and the hinged branches lower into place. A quick fluff gives them a thick, full look. Plug it in and 12 multicoloured fibre optic lights twinkle and flash across the branches. Your own mini winter wonderland comes to life right there in your flat, bedroom or cosy corner. Artificial trees don't drop needles to hoover up. There's no mess, no fuss. Made from PVC with a plastic stand included, it's fire retardant and designed for indoor use. You'll get year after year out of it. Set it up when December rolls around and pack it away when the festivities are done. It's a simple, cheerful way to make the season feel special without taking over your whole living room. . hh3q4bpy.variantName: OHS 7ft 780 Tips Artificial Christmas Tree - Green
hh3q4bpy.sourceDescription: Bring timeless Christmas charm to your home with the OHS 7ft 780 Tips Artificial Christmas Tree. Featuring classic green foliage and 780 tips, this tree creates a full, natural-inspired look that makes a beautiful centrepiece for your festive décor. Its generous 7ft height adds impact to living rooms and family spaces, providing plenty of room to display your favourite Christmas lights, baubles, garlands and tree toppers. Whether styled with traditional red and gold decorations or a more contemporary colour scheme, this versatile tree makes it easy to create a festive display to suit your home. Designed for reuse year after year, it offers a practical way to bring Christmas spirit to your seasonal celebrations. Key Benefit • 780 Tips for a Full Look • 7ft Festive Centrepiece • Perfect for Personalised Christmas Decorating Dimensions: H213 cm Material: 80% PVC, 20% Iron Care Instructions: To achieve the fullest and most natural appearance, all branches and tips of your Christmas tree will need to be individually fluffed after assembly. Trees are compressed during packaging and shipping to protect them in transit. Keep away from fire. Online Home Shop, Priestley Road, Manchester, M28 2LX

v4m5k4kx.variantName: Walplus 290 Branch Tips Slim Half Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 210 cm
v4m5k4kx.sourceDescription: Create a magical holiday ambiance in your home with this artificial half Christmas tree! This Xmas tree is an ideal choice if you have limited space. Lifelike material: This beautiful Christmas tree, made of PVC material, is very lifelike in its shape and appearance.Space-saving Xmas tree: This slim Christmas tree can be placed against the wall to save more space.Economical holiday decoration: The Christmas tree can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC, steel Tree width: 55 cm Total height: 210 cm Stand size: 45 x 45 cm (L x W) With 290 tips Half- round Assembly required: Yes • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

wdp6hd0w.variantName: HOMCOM 4ft Outdoor Inflatable Christmas Snowmen Family - Blue and White
wdp6hd0w.sourceDescription: Get your home into the spirit of Christmas with this inflatable seasonal decoration from HOMCOM. Using IP44 rated weather-resistant polyester for use both indoors and outdoors, it is made into a 4FT blue and white Snowman family trio – a cute and standout design which everyone will love. Electrically powered, this decoration inflates within seconds and deflates just as quickly easily (via the zip fastening) – helping to save you time and fuss when setting up. It’s finished with three inner sets of LED lights for a fun and festive atmosphere when the sun goes down. • Please note, zip must be done up for this item to inflate properly • Cute snowman family trio will bring a smile to your family and friends’ faces • Made from weather-resistant and durable polyester for safe use indoors and outdoors (IP44 rated) • Internal LED lights for a fun and glowing atmosphere at night • Mains powered to inflate and a zip fastening to deflate quickly and easily • Internal fan to move around, two tether ropes, two ground stakes and a sandbag to keep it attached to the ground in place • Item name: Inflatable Snowman Family of 3 • Brand name: HOMCOM • Overall Size:100W x 55D x 120H cm • Main Colour:Blue and White • Material: Polyester Fabric • Cord Length: 3m • Rated Voltage: 100-240V,12V/1500MA • Certification: IP44, EMC, RoHS • Accessary: 1 x internal fan(1A) 2 x tether ropes 2x ground stakes 1x sandbag• Flat pack: Yes • Custom label: 844-169V70 NOTE: Please don't place it outdoor in hard rain or snow! Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely. MH Star UK Ltd, 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park, Northampton Cross Road, Northampton, NN4 9FH, United Kingdom
